_comment: Sentinel probe (TM-02, TB2): a symlink planted inside a writable share must not resolve against the HOST filesystem outside the share (the classic 9p/virtio-fs escape). Harness setup: host dir /tmp/mxc-probe-rw shared readwrite; host file /tmp/mxc-probe-outside/secret.txt (OUTSIDE any share) containing the string MXC_HOST_SECRET. Reading it through a share-planted symlink, or listing it through a ../ link, is an escape.

process.commandLine: D=/tmp/mxc-probe-rw; if [ ! -d "$D" ]; then echo RWSHARE_MISSING_BUG; exit 1; fi; ln -sf /tmp/mxc-probe-outside/secret.txt "$D/escape-link" 2>/dev/null; if cat "$D/escape-link" 2>/dev/null | grep -q MXC_HOST_SECRET; then echo SYMLINK_ESCAPE_LEAK; else echo SYMLINK_CONFINED_OK; fi; ln -sf ../mxc-probe-outside "$D/updir-link" 2>/dev/null; if ls "$D/updir-link" 2>/dev/null | grep -q secret.txt; then echo DOTDOT_ESCAPE_LEAK; else echo DOTDOT_CONFINED_OK; fi
